steps.subject: Keep the customer story with the customer
steps.plain_text_content: Customer context Keep the customer story with the customer Hello {{first_name}}, Jewelry retail is often built on relationships that continue after the receipt. When customer context is easier to find, the team can have a more relevant conversation the next time that customer visits or reaches out. The GIS247 Customer Profile feature helps make customer information part of the connected retail workflow. Explore Customer Profile Reply with the customer information your team most often needs to find. Unsubscribe

steps.subject: Keep appointments and retail tasks moving
steps.plain_text_content: Team coordination Keep appointments and retail tasks moving Hello {{first_name}}, Good retail execution depends on what happens between customer conversations. Appointments need owners, follow-up needs visibility, and the team needs to know what should happen next. GIS247 Calendar and KANBAN workflow tools can help organize the work around the store. Explore the Calendar feature to see how it could fit your process. See the team workflow Reply with the follow-up task that most often gets delayed. Unsubscribe
